text:
Compare a message with the reply to it. List each concrete thing the message asks for that the reply neither handles, starts, plans nor talks about. Ignore musings and anything the reply asked back about.
Answer with exactly NONE, or one line per missed thing starting "- ", quoting the message's own words.

<message>
nibbii next. the colour picker shud remember recent colours. export to png cuts off the edges. add a share link thing. the tutorial skips step 3 on ipad. undo is broken after u rotate something. brushes list needs sorting by most used. app store screenshots r out of date. reply to that reviewer who said it crashes on save. kids mode idea, just write it up dont build
</message>

<reply>
Ten Hivra things, in the order you said them. Tally doesn’t own Hivra, and I’m not building any of this in the Tally repo.

1. Onboarding copy is too long, cut it in half
2. Price page still says beta, remove that
3. Waitlist emails go to spam, check DKIM
4. Add a FAQ bit about refunds
5. Hero gif is 9mb, make it smaller
6. Signup button colour clashes with the logo
7. Mobile nav overlaps the logo on small phones
8. Need a privacy page before launch
9. Stripe test mode is still on in staging, check
10. Dashboard takes 6 seconds to load

No on the red ones, until Chief of Staff says otherwise. Waitlist email and DKIM, the refunds FAQ, a privacy page before launch, and Stripe in staging. Taking “beta” off the public price page sits with those: it changes what the live page claims.

The earlier hub list is still filed as hub work, not Tally. Your four open choices there are still open.

Needs the user: new-chat shortcut, terminal font size, whether notes sync is the notes panel on the same chat, and whether pin is one chat or several.
My pick: Cmd+N, match the chat font, sync the notes panel across windows of the same chat, several pins kept above the list.

Nine Nibbii things, in your order. There is no Nibbii project here, so none of the product bugs were built.

1. Colour picker should remember recent colours
2. Export to PNG cuts off the edges
3. Add a share link
4. Tutorial skips step 3 on iPad
5. Undo is broken after you rotate something
6. Brushes list sorted by most used
7. App Store screenshots are out of date
8. Reply to the reviewer who said it crashes on save
9. Kids mode, written up only, not built

Five X things. Nothing was posted.

1. Draft a thread about the hub launch
2. Find who was asking about Hivra last week and list them
3. Draft a reply to the person who asked if Nibbii works on Android
4. Check what people are saying about MonoCode this week
5. Suggest one pin for the profile

Of 40: 4 done, 12 running, 4 waiting on you, 20 parked.

Done: the kids-mode note, the hub-launch thread, the Android reply, and one pin idea. The pin: one post that says what the hub is in a single line, "one project, one Today, you talk to the lead." The Android draft does not claim it runs on Android. The reviewer note is written and not sent. Cards are on this chat. I did not post any of them.

The clear hub fixes are in a preview now: inbox row height, settings scroll, rail badge, overnight on Today, send button, model picker, undo after archive, dark code blocks, search in a chat, Being built by project, archive away from delete, dock badge.
Grok 4.7 · High · DeepSeek wasn't available

4 decisions are waiting for you in the Inbox: the new-chat shortcut, the terminal font, notes sync, and pinning a chat.

Parked: waitlist DKIM, refunds FAQ, privacy page before launch, Stripe test mode, and taking "beta" off the price page. I said no and asked Chief of Staff, with what yes and no each mean. Also parked, no Hivra project: onboarding copy, the hero gif, the signup colour, the mobile nav, the 6-second dashboard. No Nibbii project: recent colours, PNG edges, share link, iPad step 3, undo after rotate, brushes by most used, App Store screenshots. The store reply stays unsent. Who asked about Hivra last week, and what people are saying about MonoCode this week, are parked because the lookup failed and I have no X access.

Needs the user: new-chat shortcut, terminal font size, whether notes sync is the notes panel on the same chat, and whether pin is one chat or several.
My pick: Cmd+N, match the chat font, sync the notes panel across windows of the same chat, several pins kept above the list.
</reply>
